newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMP raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMP raised to outperform.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Thursday it raised its rating on the shares of AMP Inc to outperform from neutral.
-- Analyst Shelby Fleck said the company's second quarter results indicated that AMP's cost-cutting efforts were starting to yield results.
-- "It was also clear from their conference call that demand for connectors is improving across both regions and product sectors," she said.
-- AMP reported second quarter earnings of $0.49 per share, including a one-time charge, compared to $0.53 per share. Sales rose to $1.47 billion from $1.37 billion.
